decision: G7 BLOCKED until independent human assessment and legitimate target-domain journal corpus exist.

criticalMeaningErrors.definition: Changed polarity, modality/conclusion strength, entity, number-to-claim assignment, units, formula operator/variable, omitted critical content, or invented claim.

literalIntegrity.definition: All required source scientific literals/opaque IDs preserved exactly except explicitly approved equivalent notation.

extractionCoverage.definition: Every critical region extracted or flagged unresolved; unresolved critical region blocks acceptance, not counted as fully covered.

falseWarningRate.requires: Human-adjudicated faithful pairs; mutation tests tracked separately.

humanProcedure.instructions: Review blinded baseline/CP18 outputs against source PDF and text. Record exact segment ID, severity, reason, corrected reference, reviewer identity/qualification/date. Adjudicate disagreements. AI ratings do not satisfy human approval.

realJournalExtension.action: Owner supplies lawful redistributable target journals with source/license and two independent bilingual scientific reviewers plus adjudicator.

rules: Never change thresholds after observing failures.
Never remove failed holdout cases from denominator.
Do not tune on holdout. Any tuning invalidates its held-out status and requires a fresh set.
Report inference, validator mutations, PDF extraction, browser tests, and human judgments separately.
